_about: Demo topics (lib/demo/topics.ts). A question's topic is the first entry whose pattern (a case-insensitive regex) matches its slide's title: the first 140 characters of the slide's text in private/pipeline/COP3530/docs.json. Slides with no text title (image-only titles, bullets only) are listed by hand in untitled. Then merges are applied in order while there are more than max topics. No model is called.
